::: {.callout-note appearance="simple"}
**Due Friday 5:00pm** as section 1 of `notebooks/week00.qmd`. This entry is not graded; it exists so the loop works before Week 1 counts. Topic: [Preparing for Class](../lectures/00-before.qmd). Checklist and rubric: [How We Work](../how-we-work.qmd#the-weekly-notebook-entry).
:::

## Goal

Have a working repository with the standard layout, one notebook entry rendered and pushed, and a Project Proposal issue open. After this week you should never have to think about *where* work goes again.

## Tasks

1. **Create your repository** from the [project template](https://github.com/course-fish546-2026/project-template) into the course organization. Name it something short and yours (for example `lastname-546`). The template already contains the standard layout:

```text
code/        data/raw/  data/processed/   output/   notebooks/   docs/
```

2. **Clone it** into `~/GitHub/` on your computer (Tutorial 1).
3. **Edit each `README.md`** inside `code/`, `data/`, and `output/` so it says, in one or two sentences, what belongs there.
4. **Confirm `data/raw/` is ignored.** Open `.gitignore` and check the line is present. Raw data are never committed.
5. **Use the shell** to write a recursive listing of your repository to `output/week00/file-list.txt`:

```bash
mkdir -p output/week00
find . -path ./.git -prune -o -type f -print | sort > output/week00/file-list.txt
```

6. **Write your first notebook entry.** Copy `notebooks/_template.qmd` to `notebooks/week00.qmd`. In section 1, describe what you set up and paste the first ten lines of the file list. Fill in the other sections briefly (your draft project idea counts as progress). Render it.
7. **Commit and push.** Both the `.qmd` and the rendered `.html`.
8. **Open a Project Proposal issue** on the [course repository](https://github.com/sr320/course-fish546-2026/issues/new/choose). A rough draft is fine. Then post the commit link from step 7 as the first comment.

## What goes in your notebook entry

- A short description of what you did and which platform you did it on.
- The head of `output/week00/file-list.txt`.
- Any setup problem you still have, so it can be fixed before Week 1.

## Assessment

Not scored. The instructor will confirm on your Project Proposal issue that the repository, layout, rendered entry, and issue are all in place. Anything missing gets fixed in the Week 1 Thursday session.
